purpose: Prove before RCLE output access that the generator is a deterministic non-planar 3D intervention with valid SE(3) projection, depth-dependent translation parallax, occlusion handling, six-arm pairing and source-known approach geometry.
forbidden_shortcuts: single plane or stacked image planes used as the whole scene
warpPerspective or one homography used to generate an analysis arm
2D flow painted onto frames without 3D reprojection and visibility
quality operators that modify camera pose, mesh, depth or visibility
seed replacement, scene filtering or gate relaxation after RCLE output
using RCLE response, trigger, support, feature collapse or FB output in geometry validation

working_camera.pixel_format: linear-RGB rendered then deterministic sRGB uint8 transport
working_camera.axis_contract: portrait image with array shape [height=640,width=360,channels=3]; u is width/x and v is height/y; K[0,2]=182.3389 and K[1,2]=321.654
working_camera.transport_boundary: The synthetic adapter must pass this source-native K and camera pose to the unchanged R3 core; it may not reuse ADVIO lens distortion or T_cam_imu as synthetic truth.

scene_contract.grid_depth_diversity: At least 7 of 9 fixed image cells contain at least two depth bands, each occupying at least 5 percent of valid cell pixels.
source_truth_outputs: scene, material, light, camera and frame manifests
scene_contract.determinism: Same implementation lock, runtime lock and seed must reproduce byte-identical manifests and uint8 transport frames.

trajectory_contract.periodic_arm: endpoint-closed response-blind 0.7-3.0 Hz SE(3) residual path from the protocol contract
trajectory_contract.containment_policy: The scene must contain the unscaled path. Collision, clipping or out-of-view failure makes that block/seed invalid and cannot be repaired by scaling or replacing the seed in R2.

quality_pairing_contract.clean: No blur, albedo contraction, sensor noise or codec loss.
quality_pairing_contract.blur: Only the globally frozen response-blind Gaussian PSF is applied after clean rendering.
quality_pairing_contract.low_texture: Only the globally frozen response-blind material-albedo contraction is applied before rendering.
identity_checks: Metric depth, object-id, camera pose, intrinsics, timestamps and visibility masks are byte-identical across CLEAN, BLUR and LOW_TEXTURE at a fixed motion level.
Scene graph, mesh geometry, material source identity and lighting are identical across both motion levels.
All six arm manifests share one cluster_id and differ only in the declared motion and quality fields.

analytic_fixtures.camera_motion: identity over two frames at dt=1/60 s
analytic_fixtures.geometry: three fronto-parallel checkerboard plates at z={1,3,9} m plus an offset cube

analytic_fixtures.camera_motion: +0.05 m camera-x translation, zero rotation, over one 1/60 s pair
analytic_fixtures.geometry: three non-coplanar textured plates at z={1,3,9} m with overlapping bearings

analytic_fixtures.purpose: source-known radial expansion and divergence sign
analytic_fixtures.camera_motion: +0.05 m camera optical-z forward translation, zero rotation, over one 1/60 s pair
analytic_fixtures.geometry: three non-coplanar textured plates at z={1,3,9} m with off-axis points in every 3x3 cell

analytic_fixtures.camera_motion: +5 degree yaw, zero translation, over one 1/60 s pair
analytic_fixtures.geometry: identical source bearings instantiated at z={1,3,9} m without mutual occlusion

analytic_fixtures.camera_motion: +0.10 m camera-x translation over one 1/60 s pair
analytic_fixtures.geometry: one near box at z=1.5 m partially occluding one far textured plane at z=6 m

analytic_fixtures.camera_motion: constant-velocity optical-axis approach over the block's exact 601 pair timestamps, scaled only to produce exactly 25 percent inverse-depth increase at the designated middle-depth target
analytic_fixtures.geometry: non-planar main-scene template with one designated persistent middle-depth target and near/far background

required_gates.scope: every main and guardrail scene seed at the reference frame
required_gates.metric: valid depth coverage and three-band coverage
required_gates.pass: valid_depth_fraction>=0.90 AND each depth band fraction>=0.10
required_gates.rationale: Ensures visible near, middle and far geometry rather than a single plane.

required_gates.metric: 3x3 cells with at least two populated depth bands
required_gates.pass: count>=7 of 9, with each present band>=0.05 of valid cell pixels
required_gates.rationale: Supports local flow decomposition without concentrating all parallax in one region.

required_gates.scope: all analytic fixtures plus 10000 deterministic visible point-time samples per block
required_gates.metric: renderer flow versus K*T*X reprojection error at the 360x640 working resolution
required_gates.rationale: Bounds renderer, pose, convention and projection mistakes below the LK measurement scale.
required_gates.sample_rule: Enumerate persistent visible samples as (block,scene_seed,frame_index,object_id,v,u), hash the UTF-8 tuple with SHA-256, sort ascending by digest then tuple, and take the first 10000 per block.

required_gates.rationale: A static intervention must not contain renderer or camera jitter.

required_gates.pass: Spearman>=0.90 AND near-band median flow / far-band median flow>=2.0
required_gates.rationale: Directly proves translation parallax with near/far separation.

required_gates.scope: PURE_TRANSLATION_LATERAL_MULTI_DEPTH and every periodic block on the single scene derived from uint64(first_8_bytes(SHA256('RCLE_PERIODIC_SELF_MOTION_COUNTERFACTUAL_R2|GEOMETRY|00')))
required_gates.pass: median residual>=0.50 px while G03 passes
required_gates.rationale: Prevents a planar homography generator from satisfying the experiment.

required_gates.metric: flow disagreement for identical bearings at different depths
required_gates.rationale: Checks the source-known rotation component independently of translation parallax.

required_gates.metric: z-buffer visibility mismatch and invalid cross-occlusion correspondences
required_gates.pass: visibility mismatch fraction<=0.001 AND invalid visible correspondence count=0
required_gates.rationale: Flow truth must not compare points that are no longer visible.

required_gates.metric: exported camera pose versus frozen intended pose
required_gates.pass: max translation error<=0.0000001 m AND max rotation-angle error<=0.0000001 rad
required_gates.rationale: Prevents renderer transport from changing the frozen waveform.

required_gates.pass: translation<=0.000001 m AND rotation angle<=0.000001 rad
required_gates.rationale: Separates periodic self-motion from net approach or drift.

required_gates.pass: 80 of 80 clusters contain exactly six unique arms and zero undeclared field differences

required_gates.metric: depth, object-id, pose, K, timestamp and visibility hashes across quality levels
required_gates.pass: all required hashes equal within each motion level
required_gates.rationale: Ensures quality is manipulated independently from geometry.

required_gates.metric: source-known visible-point depth and radial expansion
required_gates.pass: inverse depth increases by>=0.20, at least 0.95 of persistent visible points decrease monotonically in depth, and median radial expansion>=0.05/s
required_gates.rationale: Creates a positive guardrail without deriving truth from RCLE.

required_gates.scope: all analytic fixtures and one calibration seed per block before formal authorization
required_gates.metric: manifest and uint8 frame hash replay
required_gates.rationale: Allows bounded staging and later exact regeneration without retaining every rendered frame.

local_flow_truth_checks.grid: fixed 3x3 over the valid image rectangle
local_flow_truth_checks.coordinate_normalization: x=(u-cx)/fx, y=(v-cy)/fy, velocity per source-native dt
local_flow_truth_checks.center_rule: radial and tangential are NA below normalized radius 0.02
local_flow_truth_checks.clean_lk_parity_future_gate: The later implementation lock must freeze an LK-versus-source-flow error gate using analytic fixtures before any main RCLE output; this spec does not invent an empirical tolerance without the implementation.

validation_order: freeze generator source, renderer/runtime versions and deterministic seed implementation
materialize all 80 main and 8 guardrail scene manifests and all four trajectories without RCLE
validate every required geometry and pairing gate without RCLE
perform response-blind quality calibration and freeze a separate strength lock
run isolated independent validation that imports neither the generator producer nor RCLE
only then permit a separate decision on formal R2 execution

terminal_logic.repair_policy: No seed replacement, gate lowering or planar fallback. A material repair requires a new reviewed geometry spec or evidence version.

required_future_artifacts: generator implementation lock with source and environment hashes
trajectory manifest with per-frame pose hashes
